mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 jobs in the same month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS decreases > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing at a rate above 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong demand for new homes, boosting related industries and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 3% YoY and real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals a robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO YoY > 3% and GDPC1 YoY > 2%.
